text:
Alejandra: FYI ran into confusing error surface in the TypeScript SDK while walking someone through the quickstart — the thrown error is just "Request failed" with a 500 code and no retry hint.
Samir: Ugh. Is that coming from our HTTP layer or from the SDK wrapper?
Alejandra: Looks like the runtime returns an internal error object but our SDK maps it to a generic Error with message trimmed. Example: `Error: Request failed` and `statusCode: 500` in the console. No structured fields.
Megan: That makes onboarding painful. New users copy paste that and can't tell whether it's a transient quota/capacity issue or a prompt bug.
Tyler: We agreed previously on a typed-exception shape: `{ kind, message, status, retryable?, hint? }` — are we still aligned on that?
Samir: Yes, that's the goal. But parity across SDKs fell behind because Go/Java kept returning native http errors. TS got the worst of the sanitization.
Alejandra: Repro steps I gave in sample app: call the streaming chat endpoint while the model pool is under simulated load (I throttled with `--concurrency 50`). Observed messages: `deploy-bot: release 2026-03-11 started` then three failures all show the same generic text.
deploy-bot: release 2026-03-11 started :rocket:
Megan: Can we ship a minimal change that preserves the original payload under `.raw` and also exposes a typed `RedwoodError`? That solves debugging for now.
Tyler: Proposed surface: `class RedwoodError extends Error { code: string; status: number; retryAfter?: number; hint?: string; raw?: string }` and we map HTTP 429/503 -> `retryable: true` with `hint: 'backoff:exponential'` when `Retry-After` is present.
Samir: Important: 502 vs 500 — 502 usually means upstream mismatch, probably retryable for short windows. 500 could be model-level fatal error, treat as non-retry by default but surface `raw` so customers can decide.
Alejandra: Agree. Also we need copy clarity: avoid internal jargon like "KV-collision" in top-line message. Put that in `raw` and use human text for message.
Megan: UX ask — docs and quickstart should show the pattern: `try { } catch (e) { if (e.retryable) retry(); else showUserError(e.message); }` with a code sample.
Tyler: I'll draft the TS change and add `error.code` values like `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`, `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT`, `INVALID_INPUT`. Keep them stable strings.
Samir: Need to coordinate with Go/Java teams so codes map 1:1. Add a table to the API repo mapping HTTP status -> recommended code + retryable flag.
Alejandra: Also add a short onboarding note: "If your app sees repeated 5xxs for >30s, switch to a lower-capacity model or route to dedicated pool" — helps product folks.
Megan: Could we auto-attach a `sample_id` when errors occur from the quickstart so support can link back to logs? That would reduce back-and-forth in early trials.
Tyler: We can add `x-sample-id` header in quickstart requests. Add a short TTL on server logs for privacy.
Samir: Action items: Tyler to open PR for TS typed exception + preserve raw payload (ETA 2 days). Samir to draft cross-SDK mapping doc and ping Go/Java owners (ETA EOD Wed). Megan to add quickstart snippet and docs note. Alejandra to add repro and sample logs to the issue.
Alejandra: Thanks — tagging @Samir so we don't forget parity. :thumbsup: 
Samir: On it. I'll create the mapping doc and include examples of `Retry-After` handling and a recommended exponential backoff snippet.
Megan: Great. After PR lands let's do a 30-min docs sync to update onboarding content.
Tyler: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ts/pull/412 (WIP) — contains `RedwoodError` type and tests for 429/503 mapping.
Alejandra: Nice. Leaving a small nit: make sure the top-level error message is <= 140 chars for UX readability.
Samir: Noted. We'll also add a single-line user-facing message and an optional longer `raw` blob.
Megan: Sounds like a plan. If anyone runs into more variants (e.g., `422` validation shaping), drop them in this thread so we can add codes for them.
Tyler: Will do. Thanks team. :pray:
